data.titulo: Part 4—Israel Lal Hmasa Ber Aṭanga Babulon Saltânna
data.contenido:
Saula chu Israel lal hmasa ber a ni a. Mahse Jehovan amah chu a hnawl a, a aia lalber ni turin Davida thlan a ni a. Davida chanchin tam tak kan hmuchhuak a. A tleirawl laiin mihrawl Goliatha a sual a. A hnuah lalber thikthuchhia Saula hnen atangin a tlan bo va. Tin hmeltha Abigailiin thil atthlak tih a bantir a.

A dawtah, Israel lalber Davida hmun luahtu, Davida fapa Solomona chanchin tam tak kan hre leh a. Israel lal hmasa pathumte chuan kum 40 theuh an awp a. Solomona thih hnuah Israel ram chu hmar lam leh chhim lam ram, ram hniha sem a ni ta a.

Hmar lam hnam 10 ram chuan Assuria-in a tihboral hma kum 257 a daih a. Tin a hnu kum 133-ah, chhim lam hnam hnih ram pawh chu tihboral a ni ve a. Chumi lai chuan Israel-mite chu Babulon-ah sala hruai an ni a. Tichuan BUNG LI hian kum 510 chhung chanchin a huap a, chumi chhung chuan thil thleng thin khawih thei tam tak kan hmu a ni.

SAMUELAN mipa lua hriak a leih hi en teh. Lalber atana thlan a ni tawh tih lantir turin hei hi mi chunga an tih thin chu a ni. Jehovan Saula lua hriak leih turin Samuela a hrilh a. Hriak rimtui bik a ni.

Saula chuan lalber ni tura tha tawkah a inngai lo va. Israel-a a te ber Benjamina hnama mi ka ni. Engvanginnge lalber ka ni ang tih i sawi? tiin Samuela a zawt a. Mi lian leh pawimawh nih der a tum loh avangin Jehovan Saula a duh a. Chuvangin Lalber ni turin a thlang a ni.

Mahse Saula chu mi rethei emaw mi te emaw a ni lo. Mi hausa chhungkuaa mi a ni a, mi hmeltha, sang tak a ni. Israel rama tu ai pawhin kephah chen velin a sawng zawk a! Saula chu tlan pawh a chak em em a, mi chak em em a ni. Jehovan lalber ni tura Saula a thlang chu mipui an lawm a. ‘Lalber chu dam rei rawh se,’ tiin an au dual dual mai a ni.

Israel hmelmate chu an chak ngaiin an chak reng a. Israel-mite tan buaina tam tak an la awmtir a. Lalbera Saula siam a nih hnu lawkah, anmahni do turin Amon-mite an lo chho va. Mahse Saulan sipairual tam tak a khawm a, Ammon-mite chu a hneh a.

Saula lalber a ni chuan mipui a tihlim hle a. Kumte a ral zel a, Saula chuan Israel-mite hma a hruaiin, an hmelmate a hnehpui zel a. Saula chuan fapa huaisen, a hming Jonathana a nei bawk a. Jonathana chuan indona tam tak hneh turin Israel-mite a tanpui a. Philistia mite chu Israel hmelma tha lo ber an la ni reng a. Ni khat chu Israel-mite do turin Philistia-mite sang tam tak an lo kal a.

Samuelan Saula chu, a lo kal a, Jehova hnena inthawina emaw thilpek emaw a rawn siam thlenga nghak turin a hrilh a. Mahse, Samuela a lo kal muangchang a. Saula chuan Philistia-miten indo an tan mai ang tih a hlau va, tichuan amahin inthawina a siam ta a. A tawpa Samuela a lo kal chuan Saula chu thu awih lo a ni tih a hrilh a. ‘Israel chhunga lalber ni turin Jehovan mi dang a thlang ang,’ Samuelan a ti a.

A hnuah Saulan thu a awih lo leh a. Chuvangin Samuelan: ‘Beram tha bera a hnena thilpek pek aiin thu awih hi a tha zawk. Jehova thu i awih loh tak avangin Jehovan Israel lalberah a duh ta lo che a ni,’ tiin a hrilh a.

He mi atang hian zir tur tha tak kan hre thei. Jehova thu awih reng pawimawhzia min hriattir a ni. Saula anga mi tha thin pawh, a inthlakin a rawn tha lo thei tih pawh a lantir a. Tha lo nih kan duh ngai lo a ni lawm ni?1 Samuela bung 9 aṭanga 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samuela 1:23. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ENGE lo ni ta i hre thei em? Naupang hian he beram hi savawm lak ata a chhanhim a ni. Savawm a lo kal a, beram no a pu a, a ei dawn a. Mahse naupang hian a um a, savawm ka ata beram no hi a chhandam a. Tin savawm a thawh chuan, naupang hian savawm chu a man a, a vaw hlum a. Hun dangah pawh sakeibaknei lak ata beram zinga pakhat a chhandam bawk a. Naupang huai a ni lawm ni? Tunge a nih i hria em?

Hei hi tlangval Davida a ni. Bethlehem khawpuiah a cheng a. A pu chu Ruthi leh Boaza fapa Obeda a ni. I la hre reng em? Tin Davida pa chu Jessaia a ni a. Davida chuan a pa beram a enkawl a. Davida chu Jehovan lalber ni tura Saula a thlan hnu kum 10-ah a piang a ni.

Jehovan Samuela hnenah: ‘Hriak pawimawh bik keng la, Bethlehem-a Jessaia inah kal rawh. Lalber ni turin a fapate zinga pakhat ka thlang tawh e,’ a tih hun a lo thleng a. Samuelan Jessaia fapa upa ber Eliaba a hmuh chuan, a rilruin: ‘Jehova thlan chu hei hi a ni ngei mai,’ a ti a. Mahse Jehovan: ‘Engtia sang leh hmeltha nge a nih en suh. Lalber ni turin ka thlang lo ve,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Chuvangin Jessaian a fapa Abinadaba a ko va, Samuela hnenah a rawn hruai a Mahse Samuelan: ‘Ni lo, Jehovan ani pawh a thlang lo,’ a ti a. A dawtah, Jessaian a fapa Sama a rawn hruai a. ‘Ni lo, Jehovan ani pawh a thlang bawk lo,’ Samuelan a ti a. Jessaian a fate zinga pasarih Samuela hnenah a rawn hruai a, mahse an zinga tumah Jehovan a thlang lo va. ‘Heng hi naupang zawng zawng em ni?’ tiin Samuelan a zawt a.

‘A naupang ber a la awm, mahse beram vengin a chhuak,’ Jessaian a ti a. Davida a rawn hruai luh chuan, naupang hmeltha tak a nih tih Samuelan a hmu thei a. ‘Hei hi a ni. A chungah hriak leih rawh,’ Jehovan a ti a. Samuelan a leih ta a. Davida chu Israel lal a nih hun a la thleng ang.1 Samuela 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ISRAEL do turin Philistia-mite an lo kal leh a. Davida u pathumte chu tunah Saula sipai rualah an tel a. Chutichuan ni khat chu Jessaian Davida hnenah buh leh chhang keng la. Engtinnge an awm va hre rawh,’ a ti a.

Davidan sipai riah hmun a thlenin a unaute zawngin indona hmunah a kal a. Philistia mihrawl Goliatha chu Israel-mite nuihsan turin a lo chhuak a. Chu chu ni 40 chhung, zing tin leh tlai tin a lo tih tawh thin a ni. ‘Mi do turin in zinga pakhat thlang rawh u. Mi hneh a mi tihhlum chuan, in bawite kan ni ang a. Mahse keiin ka hneh a, amah ka tihhlum chuan kan bawite in ni ang. Mi do turin tuemaw ka thlantir ngam a che u,’ tiin a au va. Davidan sipai thenkhat a zawt a: ‘He Philistia mi hi tihlum a, he hmingchhiatna atanga Israel tifihlimtuin enge a hlawh ang?’ tiin.

Sipai chuan: ‘Chu mi chu Saulan a hausakna tam tak a pe ang a. Tin a nupui atan a fanu a pe bawk ang,’ a ti a.

Mahse a len em vangin Israel-mite zawng zawng chuan Goliatha chu an hlau va. Ft 9 (meter 3) vel aia sang a ni a, a phaw ken saktu sipai dang a nei a.

Sipai thenkhat an kal a, Davidan Goliatha do a duh tih Lalber Saula an hrilh a. Mahse Saula chuan Davida hnenah: ‘He Philistia hi i do thei lo vang. Naupang mai i ni a, ani chu a chhung zawng sipai a ni tawh,’ a ti a. Davida chuan: ‘Ka pa beram latu sakeibaknei leh savawm ka tihlum tawh. He Philistia pawh hi an zinga pakhat ang chu a ni mai ang. Jehovan mi tanpui ang,’ a ti a. Chuvangin Saula chuan: ‘Kal rawh le, i hnenah Jehova awm rawh se,’ a ti ta a.

Davida chu luiah a chhuk a, lung te mam panga a chhar a, a ipah a dah a. Tin a virvawm a la a, mihrawl pui tawk tur chuan a kal ta a. Goliathan amah a hmuhin a awih thei lo va. Davida tihhlum chu awlsam deuh niin a ring a.

‘Ka hnenah lo kal la, i taksa chu savate leh ramsate hnenah ei turin ka pe ang e,’ Goliathan a ti a. Mahse Davida chuan: ‘Ka hnenah khandaih leh fei leh fei zang chi nen i lo kal a, kei chu i hnenah Jehova hmingin ka lo kal a ni. Vawiinah hian Jehovan ka kutah a pe ang chia, ka vawm hlum dawn che a ni,’ a ti a.

Chu veleh Davida chu Goliatha lamah a tlan a. A ipa lung chu a la a, a virvawmah a dah a, theih tawpin a vawm a. Lung chuan Goliatha lu ngeiah a fuh a, a tlu hlum ta der a! Philistia-miten an mi chak a tlu ta tih an hmuhin, an tlan kir ta vek a. Israelmiten an um a, an hneh ta a.1 Samuela 17:1-54. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

DAVIDAN Goliatha a tihhlum hnuah, Israel sipai rual hotu Abneran ani chu Saula hnenah a hruai a. Saulan Davida a lawm em em a. A sipai rual hotuah a siam a, lalber ina cheng turin a hruai a.

A hnuah, Philistia-mite dona atanga sipai rual an haw laiin: ‘Saulan sang tam tak a tihlum, Davidan sing tam tak,’ tiin hmeichhiaten hla an sa a. Chu chuan Saula aiin Davida chu chawimawi a hlawhtir zawk vangin Saula a thiktir a. Mahse Saula fapa Jonathana chuan a thik lo. Davida a hmangaih em em a, Davida pawhin Jonathana a hmangaih ve a. Chuvangin an pahnihin thian ni reng turin thu an tiam a. Davida chu tingtang tum thiam deuh mai a ni a, a tum ri chu Saulan ngaihnawm a ti a. Mahse ni khat chu Saula thikthuchhiatna chuan thil rapthlak tak a tihtir a. Davidan tingtang a tum laiin Saulan a fei a la a: ‘Bangah Davida ka kilh bet ang,’ tiin a khawh a. Mahse Davidan a kiansan hman a, fei chuan a fuh lo va. A hnuah Saulan Davida chu a feiin a khawh thelh leh a. Chuvangin Davida chuan a fimkhur em em tur a ni tih a hre ta a.

Saula thutiam kha i la hrereng em? Goliatha tihlumtu hnenah a nupui atan a fanu a pe ang tih a sawi a. A tawpah Saula chuan Davida hnenah a fanu Mikali a nei thei, mahse hmelma Philistia-mite 100 a tihlum hmasa tur a ni tih a hrilh a. Han ngaihtuah teh! Taktakah chuan Philistia-miten Davida an tihhlum Saulan a beisei a ni. Mahse an tihlum lo va, chuvangin Saulan a fanu chu Davida nupui ni turin a pe ta a.

Ni khat chu Saulan Jonathana leh a chhiahhlawhte zawng zawng Davida tihhlum a duh tih a hrilh a. Mahse Jonathana chuan a pa hnenah: ‘Davida tina suh. I chungah thil dik lo engmah a ti ngai lo. Thil a tih tawh apiang i tana tangkai an ni zawk. Goliatha a thah lai khan thih a huam a, i hmuhin i lawm a,’ a ti a.

Saulan a fapa thu a ngaithla a, Davida tina lo turin thu a tiam a. Davida chu a hruai leh a, a hma ang bawkin Saula inah rawng a bawl leh a. Amaherawhchu, ni khat, Davidan tumrik a tum laiin Saulan a feiin a khawh leh a. Davidan a kiansan hman, fei chuan bang a fuh a! Chu chu a vawi thumna a ni! Davida chuan a tlan bo tur a ni tih tunah chuan a hre ta!

Chumi zan chuan Davida chu ama inah a haw a. Mahse Saulan amah tihlum turin mi thenkhat a tir a. Mikalin a pa tih tum chu a hria a. Chuvangin a pasal hnenah: ‘Zanina i kal bo loh chuan, naktukah chuan i thi tawh ang,’ a ti a. Chumi zan chuan Mikalin Davida chu tukverhah a chhuahtir a. Kum sarih chhung vel chu Saulan a hmuh theih loh nan Davida chu hmun dang dangah a biru sawn a.1 Samuela 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

DAVIDA tawk tura lo kal hmeichhe hmel tha deuh hi i hria em? A hming chu Abigaili a ni. A rilru a tha a, Davida thil tha lo tihna a dal a. Mahse chu mi chanchin kan zir hmain, Davida chungah enge thleng i en ang u.

Saula hnen atanga Davida a tlan bo hnuah, pukah a biru a. Chutah chuan a unaute leh a chhungte dangin an fin a. A hnenah mipa 400 vel an lo kal a, Davida chu an hriautu a ni a. Tin Davida chu Moab lal hnenah a kal a: ‘Ka chungah enge thleng tih ka hriat hmaloh chuan, khawngaih takin ka nu leh ka pa hi i hnenah chentir ta che,’ a ti a. A hnuah Davida leh a mite chu tlangah an biru a.

Chu mi hnuah chuan Davidan Abigaili a hmu a. A pasal Nabala chu ram neitu mi hausa a ni. Beram 3,000 leh kel 1,000 a nei a. Nabala chu mi kawm deuh a ni a. Mahse a nupui Abigaili chu a hmeltha em em a. Thil dik tih dan pawh a hria a. Vawi khat chu a chhungkua pawh a chhandam a. A chhandam dan i en ang u.

Davida leh a mite chu Nabala chungah ngil an nei a. A beram an humhimpui tawh a. Chuvangin ni khat chu Davidan a mite thenkhat Nabala duhsakna ngen turin a tir a. Davida mite chu Nabala leh amah puituten beram hmul an meh laiin Nabala hnenah an lo thleng a. Ruai theh ni a ni a, Nabala chuan ei tur tha tam tak a nei a. Tichuan Davida mite chuan hei hi an sawi a: ‘I chungah ngil kan nei tawh a. I beram pakhat mah kan ru lo va, kan venpui zawk che a. Tunah khawngaih takin, chaw tlem azawng min pe ta che,’ tiin.

Nabala chuan: ‘Nangni ang mite hnenah ka chaw ka pe dawn lo,’ a ti a. Ui deuhvin a tawng a, Davida chanchin tha lo tak takin a sawi a. Mite chu an kir leh a, Davida an hrilhin Davida thin a ur ta em em a. ‘ln khandaih keng rawh u,’ tiin a mite a hrilh a. Nabala leh a mite tihlum turin an chhuak a.

Nabala thu sual sawi hretu Nabala mite zinga pakhatin thil awm dan chu Abigaili a hrilh a. Abigaili chuan chaw thenkhat a siam peih nghal a. Sabengtung thenkhat a phurhtir a, a kal ta a. Davida a tawh ve leh, sabengtung atangin a chhuk a, kunin: ‘Khawngaih takin, ka pu, ka pasal Nabala ngaihsak suh. Mi a a ni a, thil atthlak a ti thin. Heta hi thilpek. Khawngaih takin la la, thil lo ni tawhah chuan min ngaidam ang che,’ a ti a.

Davidan: ‘Hmeichhe fing i ni. A sualna thungrulhnaa Nabala tihhlumna turah mi dang si. Tunah remnain haw rawh,’ a ti a. A hnuah Nabala thih veleh Abigaili chu Davida nupui a lo ni a.1 Samuela 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Davida Chu Lalberah Siam A Ni
data.contenido:
SAULA chuan Davida man a tum leh a. A sipai tha ber ber 3,000 a hruai a, a zawng ta a. Davidan chu chu a hriatin, Saula leh a mite zan riahna hre turin enthlatute a tir a. Tin Davida chuan a mite pahnih chu: ‘Tu zawk nge Saula riahhmunah ka ruala kal ang? tiin a zawt a.

Abisaian: ‘Kei ka kal ang,’ tiin a chhang a. Abisaia chu Davida farnu Zeruii fapa a ni. Saula leh a mite muthilh hlanin Davida leh Abisaia chu zawi tein riah hmunah an vak lut a. Saula lu sir ding lama Saula fei leh tuithawl an la a. An muthilh ngheh avangin tumahin an hmu lo va, an hre bawk lo va.

Tunah Davida leh Abisaia en teh. An kal chhuak leh tawh a, tlang chhipah him takin an awm ta a. Davidan Israel sipai ruai hotu a zuk au va: ‘Abner, engvanginnge i pu, lalber chu i humhim loh? En teh! Khawiahnge a fei leh a tuithawl kha?’ tiin.

Saula a harh a, Davida aw tih a hria a, ‘Chu chu nangmah em ni, David?’ tiin a zawt a. Sawta Saula leh Abnera saw i hmu em?

‘Ni e, ka lalpa, lalber,’ tiin Davidan Saula a chhang a. ‘Engvanginnge mi man i tum? Eng thil tha lo nge ka tih? Heta hi i fei, Aw lalber. I mite zinga pakhat lo kal sela, rawn la rawh se,’ tiin Davidan a hrilh a. Saula chuan: ‘Ka lo ti dik lo a ni. Atthlak takin ka lo che a ni,’ a ti a. Chu veleh Davida chu a kalna turah a kal a, Saula a haw ta a. Mahse Davida chuan a rilruin: ‘Eng niah emaw chuan Saulan mi la tihlum ang. Philistia-mite ramah ka tlan teh ang,’ a ti a. A tlan ta a. Davida chuan Philistia-mite chu a tihder theiin, tunah chuan an lamah a tang tih a rintir thei a.

A hnu eng hunah emaw Philistia-mite chu Israel do turin an chho va. lndonaah chuan Saula leh Jonathana tihhlum an ni ve ve a. Chu chuan Davida a tilungngai em em a, hla mawi deuh a phuah a: ‘Nangmah vangin ka lungngai em mai, ka unaupa Jonathan. Ka tan i va duhawm em!’ tiin hla a sa a.

Chumi hnuah chuan Davida chu Israel-ah Hebron khawpuiah a kir a. Lalber ni tura Saula fapa Ishbosheta thlangtute leh lalber ni tura Davida duhtute an indo va. A tawpah Davida mite chuan an hneh a. Lalbera siam a nih lai chuan Davida chu kum 30-a upa a ni. Kum sarih leh a chanve Hebron-ah a lal a. Chuta a fapa neih thenkhat chu Amnona, Absaloma leh Adonija te hi an ni.

Davida leh a miten khawpui mawi tak, Jerusalem an tih la tura an chhoh hun a lo thleng a. Davida farnu Zeruii fapa dang Joaban indonaah hma a hruai a. Tichuan Davida chuan Joaba chu a sipai rual hotua siamin lawmman a pe a. Tichuan Davida chuan Jerusalem khawpuiah ro a rel tan ta a.1 Samuela 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuela 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Chronicles 11:1-9. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

JERUSALEM-a Davidan rorel a tan hnuah, a sipai rual chu Jehovan an hmelmate chunga hnehna tam tak a pe a. Jehovan Israel-mite hnenah Kanaan ram pek a tiam tawh a. Tunah Jehova tanpuinain, an hnena a tiam tawh ram zawng zawng chu a tawpah an ta a ni ta a.

Davida chu lal tha a ni. Jehova a hmangaih a. Tichuan Jerusalem a lak hnua a thiltih hmasa berte zinga pakhat chu chuta Jehova thuthlung bawm rawn lak chu a ni. A dahna turin biak in sak a duh a.

Davida a lo upatin, thil tha lo tak a tipalh a. Davida chuan mi dang ta thil engemaw lak chu a dik lo a ni tih a hria a. Mahse tlai khat chu, a lal in inchunga a awm laiin, a han en a, hmeichhe hmeltha deuh a hmu a. A hming chu Bath-sebi a ni a, a pasal chu sipaite zinga pakhat, a hming Uria a ni.

Davida chuan Bath-sebi chu a duh khawp mai a, a lal inah a hruaitir a. A pasal ral dovin a kal bo va. Davida chuan a mutpui a, a hnuah nau a nei dawn tih a hria a. Davida chuan a lungkham em em a, a sipai rual hotu Joaba hnenah Uria chu indona hmatawngah a thihna ngei tura dah turin thu a chah a. Uria a thihin Davidan Bath-sebi chu nupuiah a nei a.

Jehova chu Davida chungah a thinur em em a. A sualna chungchang hrilh turin a chhiahhlawh Nathana a tir a. Saw Davida hnena Nathanan a sawi lai saw i hmu thei. Davida chuan a thiltih chu pawi a ti em em a, chuvangin Jehovan amah a tithi lo va. Mahse Jehova chuan: ‘Heng thil tha lote hi i tih avangin, i inah buaina tam tak i nei ang,’ a ti a. Davida chuan buaina a ngah reng mai!

A hmasain, Bath-sebi fapa a thi a. A hnuah Davida fa tir Amnonan a farnu Tamari a mutpui lui a. Davida fapa Absaloman chu chu a thinrimpui khawp a, Amnona a tihlum a. A hnuah, Absaloma chuan mipui tam tak a tilawm a, lalberah a insiam a tum a. Chu veleh Davida chuan puithiam, a hming Zadoka chu Solomona lalber a ni ang tih tilang turin Solomona luah hriak a thihtir a. A hnu rei loteah Davida chu kum 70 niin a thi ta a. Kum 40 chhung a lal a, mahse tunah chuan Solomona chu Israel lalber a ni ta a.2 Samuela 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Lalte 1:1-48. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

SOLOMONA chu tleirawl te a nih laiin lalber a lo ni a. Jehova a hmangaih a, a pa Davida thu rawn tha a zawm a. Solomona chungah Jehova a lawm a, tichuan zan khat chu a mumangah a hnenah: ‘Solomon, enge pe che ila i duh ang?’ a ti a.

Solomona chuan: ‘Jehova ka Pathian, ka naupang em a, rorel dan pawh ka thiam lo va. Chuvangin kawng dika i mipuite rorel sak turin finna min pe rawh,’ tiin a chhang a.

Solomona dil chu Jehovan a lawm a. Chuvangin: ‘Dam reina emaw hausakna emaw ni lo va finna i dil avangin, nung tawh ngai tupawh aia finna tam zawk ka pe ang che. Mahse i dil loh, hausakna leh ropuina pawh ka pe ang che,’ a ti a.

A hnu rei loteah buaina khirh tak nen Solomona hnenah hmeichhe pahnih an lo kal a. Pakhat chuan: ‘He hmeichhia nen hian in khatah kan cheng a. Mipa ka hring a, ni hnih hnuah mipa a hring ve a. Tin zan khat chu a fapa chu a thi a. Mahse ka muthilh hlanin ka sirah a fa thi tawh chu a dah a, ka nausen a la a. Ka harh a, nausen thi chu ka han en chuan, ka fa a ni lo tih ka hria a,’ a ti a.

Chu veleh hmeichhe dang chuan: ‘Ni lo! Naute la dama hi ka ta a ni a, a thi hi a ta a ni, a dam hi ka ta a ni,’ a ti a. Chu chu hmeichhiate inhnial dan chu a ni. Solomonan enge a tih ang?

Khandaih a laktir a, an rawn lak chuan: ‘Nausen nung kha bung hnihah bung ula, hmeichhiate hnenah a chanve ve vein pe rawh u,’ a ti a. Nu tak chuan: ‘Ni lo ve! Khawngaih takin nausen tihlum suh u. A hnenah pe rawh u!’ a ti a. Mahse hmeichhe dang chuan: ‘A tua mah min pe suh u; bung hnihah bung rawh u,’ a ti a.

A tawpah Solomona a tawng a: ‘Naute chu tihlum suh u. Hmeichhe hmasa hnenah pe rawh u. Nu tak a ni e,’ a ti a. Nu tak chuan nausen chu a hmangaih em em a, tihlum lo va hmeichhe dang hnena pek pawh a duh avangin Solomonan chu chu a hria a ni. Mipuiin Solomona thubuai tihfel dan an hriatin, chutiang lalber fing an nei chu an lawm a.

Solomona lal chhungin, Pathianin mipui chu, buhpui leh buh sanghar, grep leh theipui leh chaw dangte leia tam tak totirin mal a sawm a. Mipuiin silhfen tha an inbel a, in thaah an cheng a. Mi tin tan thil tha tinreng a tawk aia tam a awm a ni.1 Lalte 3:3-28; 4:29-34. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

DAVIDA thih hmain, Jehova biak in sak dan tur riruang Pathian hnena mi chu Solomona a pe a. A lal kum linaah, Solomonan biak in a sa tan a, kum sarih leh a chanveah a zo va. Mi sing tam takin biak inah an thawk a, insak man chu tangka tam deuh a rai a. Chu chu rangkachak leh tangkarua an hman tam em vang a ni.

Biak in chuan pindan pui pahnih a nei a, biakbuk neih ang bawk khan. Mahse chung pindante chu biakbuka mi leh hnih an ni. Solomonan thuthlung bawm chu biak in pindan chhung zawkah chuan a dah a, biakbuka vawn thil dang chu pin dan dangah a dah a.

Biak in sak zawh a nihin chawimawina ropui tak a awm a. Biak in hmaah Solomona a thingthi a, milema i hmuh ang hian a tawngtai a: ‘Van zawng zawng pawh i lenna khawpin a zau tawh lo va, he biak inah hian i va leng lo zual dawn em! Mahse aw ka Pathian, he hmun lama i mite an tawngtai chuan khawngaih takin ngaithla ang che,’ tiin.

Solomona tawngtai zawhin, van atangin mei a lo chhuk a. lnthawina ran siam zawh sa chu a kang ral ta a. Tin Jehova hnena mi eng eng deuhvin biak in a khat a. Chu chuan Jehovan a ngaithla tih leh, biak in leh Solomona tawngtaina a lawm tih a tilang a. Biakbuk chu ni tawh lovin, biak in zawk chu tunah chuan Pathian be tura mipui lo kal khawmna hmun chu a ni ta. Rei tak chhung chu Solomonan fing takin ro a rel a, mipui pawh an hlim a. Mahse Solomona chuan Jehova be lo, ram danga mi hmeichhe tam tak nupuiah a nei a. An zinga pakhat milem hmaa pathian be lai i hmu thei em? A tawpah Solomona chu a nupuiten pathian dang an biaktir ta a. Solomonan chutia a tih chinah enge lo ni ta i hria em? Mipui chungah ngil a nei ta lo va. A tawrawt a, mipui pawh an hlim tawh lo.

Chu chuan Solomona chungah Jehova a tithinrim a, ‘I hnen atangin ram ka la bo ang a, mi dang hnenah ka pe ang. Chu chu i dam chhungin ka ti lo vang a, mahse i fapa lal chhungin ka ti ang. Mahse i fapa hnen atangin lalrama mipui zawng zawng ka la lo lo vang,’ a ti a. Chu mi thlen dan chu i en ang u.1 Chronicles 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Lalte 5:1-18; 2 Chronicles 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Lalte 11:9-13. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ENGVANGINNGE he mi hian kawrfual a pawh sawm i hria em? Jehovan ti turin a hrilh a ni. He mi hi Pathian zawlnei Ahija a ni. Zawlnei chu enge ni i hria em? A hun hmaa Pathianin enge thleng dawn tih a lo hrilh mi chu a ni.

Hetah hian Ahija chuan Jeroboama hnenah a sawi mek a. Jeroboama chu Solomonan a insak hna thenkhat thawk tura a daha chu a ni a. Ahijan heta kawnga Jeroboama a tawh lai hian, Ahija chuan thil mak tak a ti a. Kawrfual a hak lai chu a phelh a, them 12-ah a pawt thler a. Jeroboama hnenah: ‘I tan them 10 la rawh,’ a ti a. Engvanginnge Ahijan Jeroboama them 10 a pek i hria em?

Ahija chuan Solomona hnen atangin Jehovan ram a la bo dawn tih a hrilh a. Jehovan Jeroboama hnenah hnam 10 a pe dawn a ti a. Chu chu, Solomon fapa Rehoboama awp turin hnam hnih chauh hnutchhiah an ni dawn tihna a ni.

Ahijan Jeroboama thu a hrilh chu Solomonan a hriatin a thinur em em a. Jeroboama tihhlum a tum a. Mahse Jeroboama chu Aigupta-ah a tlan bo va. Rei lo deuh hnuah Solomona a thi a. Kum 40 chhung a lal a, mahse tunah chuan a fapa Rehoboama chu lalbera siam a ni ta. Aigupta-ah Jeroboaman Solomona a thi tawh tih a hria a, tichuan Israel-ah a lo haw a.

Rehoboama chu lal tha a ni lo. A pa Solomona ai mahin mipui hnenah a sual zawk a. Jeroboama leh mi pawimawh thenkhat Lalber Rehoboama hnenah an kal a, mipui chunga tha zawk turin an ngen a. Mahse Rehoboama chuan a ngaithla lo va. Dik takin, a hma aiin a rawn sual zawk a. Chuvangin mipuiin Jeroboama chu hnam 10 chunga lalah an siam ta a, mahse Benjamina leh Juda hnam hnihte chuan Rehoboama chu an lalah an nei a.

Jeroboaman a mite Jerusalema Jehova biak ina Pathian be tura an kal a duh lo va. Chuvangin rangkachak bawng pahnih a siam a, hnam 10 rama mite chu a biaktir a. Ram chu pawikhawihna leh pawngneknain a khat ta thuai a.

Hnam hnih ramah pawh buaina a awm. Rehoboama lal a nih hnu kum nga aia tlemah, Jerusalem do turin Aigupta lai a lo kal a. Jehova biak in atangin ro tam tak a la a. Chutichuan biak in chu sak a nih anga a awm chhung chu rei lote chauh a ni.1 Lalte 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

LAL Jeroboama thih hnuah, Israel hnam 10 ram awptu lal chu an tha lo theuh va. Lal Ahaba chu lal azawnga tha lo ber a ni. Engvanginnge i hria em? A chhan lian tak pakhat chu, a nupui Lalnu suaksual Jezebeli a ni.

Jezebeli chu Israel hmeichhia a ni lo. Sidon lal fanu a ni a. Pathian dik lo Baala a bia a, Ahaba leh Israel-mite tam tak Baala a biaktir ve a. Jezebelin Jehova a hua a, a zawlnei tam tak a tihlum a. A dang chu tihhlum an nih loh nan pukahte an biru a. Jezebelin thil engemaw a duh chuan, a neih theih nan mi pawh a tihlum ang.

Ni khat chu Lal Ahaba a lungngai em em a. Chuvangin Jezebelin: ‘Engvanginnge vawiin hian i lungngaih?’ tiin a zawt a.

‘Ka hnena Nabotha thusawi vangin. A grep huan lei ka duh a. Mahse ka nei thei lovang tih min hrilh a,’ tiin Ahaban a chhang a.

‘Lungkham suh, Ka neih sak ang che,’ Jezebelin a ti a.

Tichuan Jezebelin chu Nabotha chenna khawpuia mite lai thenkhat hnenah lehkha a thawn a. Nabothan Pathian leh lalber anchhia a lawh tia sawi turin mi tlaktlai lo thenkhat siam ula. Tin Nabotha chu khawpui pawnah kalpui ula, lungin deng hlum rawh u,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Jezebelin Nabotha a thi tawh tih a hriat veleh, Ahaba hnenah: ‘Tunah kal la a grep huan chu va nei rawh,’ a ti a. Chutiang thil rapthlak chu a tih avangin Jezebeli chu hrem tur a ni tih i remti lawm ni?

Chutichuan a hunah, amah hrem turin Jehovan mipa Jehua chu a tir a. Jehua a lo kal tih Jezebelin a hriatin, a mit a hnawih a, lang mawi turin a inchei a. Mahse Jehua a lo kal a, tukverha Jezebeli a hmuhin lal ina mite a ko va: ‘Paih thla rawh u!’ a ti a. Mite chuan a thu an awih a, milema i hmuh ang hian. An paih thla a, a thi ta a. Chu chu Lalnu suaksual Jezebeli tawpna chu a ni.1 Lalte 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Lalte 9:30-37. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HENG mite hi tute nge an nih a, enge an tih i hria em? lndonaah an kal mek a, hma lama mite hian hla an sa a ni.’ Engvanginnge hla satute hian indo nan khandaih leh fei an ken loh?’ tiin i zawt a ni thei a. I en ang u.

Jehosaphata chu Israel hnam hnih rama lalber a ni a. Hmar lam hnam 10 rama lalber Ahaba leh Jezebeli te ruala dam a ni. Mahse Jehosaphata chu lal tha a ni a, a pa Asa pawh lal tha a ni bawk. Chuvangin chhim lam hnam hnih rama mite chuan kum tam tak chhung nun tha nuam an chen a.

Mahse tunah mipui tihlau tur thil engemaw a awm. Zualkovin Jehosaphata hnenah: ‘Nangmah do turin Moab, Ammon leh Seir Tlang ram atangtein sipai rual tam deuh an lo kal,’ tih an rawn sawi a. Jehova tanpuina dil turin Jerusalem-ah Israel-mite tam tak an kal khawm a. Biak inah an kal a, chutah chuan Jehoeaphata a tawngtai a: ‘Aw Jehova kan Pathian, enge tih tur kan hre lo. He sipai rual tam tak Iakah hian tanpuitu kan nei lo. Tanpui turin nangmah kan thlir che a ni e,’ tiin.

Jehovan a ngaithla a, a chhiahhiawhte zianga pakhat mipuite a hrlihtir a: ‘lndona chu in ta a ni lo, Pathian ta a ni. ln do a ngai lo vang. En ringawt mai ula, Jehovan a chhandam dan tur che u hmu rawh u,’ tiin.

Chutichuan Jehosaphatan mipui a hrilh a: ‘Jehova ring rawh u!’ tiin. A sipaite hmaah hla satute a dah a, tin an kal pahin Jehova fakna hla an sa a. Indona hnaih an thlenin enge lo ni i hria em? Jehovan hmelma sipaite chu anmahni leh anmahni a indotir a. Israel-mite an lo thlen chuan, hmelma sipai zawng zawngte chu an lo thi tawh a!

Jehosaphatan Jehova a ring chu a a fing lawm ni? Amah kan rin chuan kan fing ve ang.1 Lalte 22:41-53; 2 Chronicles 20:1-30. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

I THIH a, tihnun leh i nih chuan i nuin engtinnge a ngaih ang? A hlim em em ang! Mahse mi thi tawh chu a nung leh thei em ni? Tun hmain a lo awm tawh ngai em?

Heta mipa leh hmeichhia leh naupang tetakte hi en teh. Mipa hi Zawlnei Elija a ni a. Hmeichhia hi Zerephat khawpuia hmeithai a ni a, naupang hi a fapa a ni. Ni khat chu naupang hi a dam lo va. A zual deuh deuh va. A tawpah a thi ta a. Elijan hmeichhe hnenah: ‘Naupang chu mi han pe rawh,’ a ti a.

Elijan naupang thi tawh chu inchhawngah a lawnpui a, khumah a muttir a. Tin a tawngtai a: ‘Aw Jehova, naupang hi tinung leh rawh,’ tiin. Naupang chu a thaw tan ta a! Chu veleh Elijan a chhukpui leh a, hmeichhe hnenah: ‘En teh, i fapa a nung e!’ a ti a. Chu chu heti taka hmeichhia a hlimna chhan hi a ni.

Zawlnei pawimawh dang hming chu Elisha a ni. Elija tanpuituah a tang a. Mahse a hunah Jehovan Elisha pawh thilmak ti turin a hmang a. Ni khat chu Elisha chu, a chunga hmeichhe pakhat a ngilneih em emna hmun Shunem -ah a kal a. A hnuah chu hmeichhia chuan nausen mipa a nei a.

Naupang than len deuh hnuah, tuk khat chu thlawhhmaa a pa hna thawk pui turin a kal chhuak a. Thawkkhatah naupang chuan: ‘Ka lu a na,’ tiin a au chhuak a. lna an hawpui hnuah naupang chu a thi ta a. A nu a va lungngai em! A kal nghal a, Elisha a va ko va.

Elisha a lo thlen chuan naupang thi tawh chu pindanah a pawm lut a. Jehova hnenah a tawngtai a, a taksa chungah a bawk a. Naupang taksa chu a lo lum thuai a, vawi sarih a hahchhiau va. A nu chu a lo lut a, a nau nung leh a hmu chu a va hlim em!

Mi tam tak an thi tawh a. Chu chuan an chhungte leh thiante a tilungngai em em thin. Mitthi kaihthawh theihna kan nei lo. Mahse Jehovan a nei a. A hnuah mi maktaduai tam tak a tihnun dan tur kan hria ang.1 Lalte 17:8-24; 2 Lalte 4:8-37. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Hmeichhe Naupangin Mi Chak A Ṭanpui
data.contenido:
HE HMEICHHE naupang te tak te hian enge a sawi i hria em? Jehova zawlnei Elisha leh, Jehovan thilmak tak ti tura amah a tanpui thu nu hi a hrilh a ni. Nu hi Israel-mi a nih loh avangin Jehova chanchin a hre lo. A nih leh, engvanginnge hmeichhe naupang hi nu ina a awm, i en ang u.

Nu hi Suria mi a ni. A pasal chu Suria sipai rual hotu Naamana a ni. Suria-miten he Israel hmeichhe naupang te tak te hi an man a, Naamana nupui hnenah a chhiahhlawh ni turin an rawn hruai a ni.

Naamana chuan natna tha lo, phar an tih chu a vei a. Chu natna chuan mi tisa thenkhat a titla thei a. Chuvangin hei hi hmeichhe naupang chuan Naamana nupui chu a hrilh a ni: ‘Ka pu hi lsraela Jehova zawlnei hnenah kal thei se ka ti em mai. A phar hi a tihdam ang,’ tiin. A hnuah hei hi nu pasal chu hrilh a ni a.

Naamana chuan tihdam nih a duh em em a; chuvangin Israel-a kal zai a rel ta a. Chuta a va thlen chuan, Elisha inah a kal a. Elisha chuan Naamana chu Jordan Luia kal a, vawi sarih inbual tura hrilh turin a chhiahhlawh a kal chhuahtir a. Chu chuan Naamana a tithinur em em a: ‘Kan rama luite chu Israel-a eng lui ai pawhin an tha zawk vek,’ a ti a. Chu chu a sawi zawhin Naamana chu a kal chhuak a.

Mahse a chhiahhlawhte zinga pakhatin a hnenah: ‘Ka pu, Elisha chuan thil harsa engemaw ti turin hrilh che sela chuan i ti ang a. Tunah engvanginnge a sawi anga i inbual mai loh?’ tiin a hrilh a. Naamanan a chhiahhlawh sawi a ngaithla a, a kal a, Jordan Luiah vawi sarih a inchiah a. A tih zawh chuan a tisa chu a lo dam fel ta a.

Naamana chu a hlim em em a. Elisha hnenah a kir a: ‘Tunah chuan Israela Pathian chu leilung zawng zawnga Pathian dik awmchhun chu a ni tih ka hre chiang ta. Chuvangin, khawngaih takin he thilpek hi la rawh,’ tiin a hrilh a. Mahse Elisha chuan: ‘Ni lo ve, ka la lo vang,’ a ti a. Elisha chuan Naamana tidamtu chu Jehova a nih vangin a tan thilpek lak chu a dik lo tih a hria a. Mahse Elisha chhiahhlawh Gehazia chuan thilpek chu ama tan a duh a.

Chuvangin Gehazia chuan heti hian a ti ta a: Naaman kal chhuah hnuah, amah umpha turin Gehazia a tlan a. ‘Elishan a thian lo thleng tharte tan i thilpek a then a zar a duh ang tih hrilh tur chein mi tir a ni,’ Gehazia chuan a ti a. Chu chu dawt thu a ni. Mahse Naaman chuan dawt a nih a hre lo va, chuvangin thil thenkhat chu Gehazia a pe a.

Gehazia a lo haw chuan Elishan a thiltih chu a hria a. Jehovan amah a hrilh a. Chuvangin: ‘He thil tha lo hi i tih avangin, Naamana phar chu i chungah a thleng ang,’ a ti a. A thleng ta nghal a.

Heng zawng zawng atang hian enge kan hriat theih? Pakhatnaah: hmeichhe naupang ang chu kan niin Jehova chanchin kan sawi tur a ni, tih hi a ni a. Pahnihnaah chuan, a tira Naaman anga chapo kan ni tur a ni lo va, Pathian chhiahhlawh thu kan awih tura ni a. Tin pathumnaah chuan Gehazia angin dawt kan sawi tur a ni lo. Bible-a mi chhiarin tam tak kan hre thei lawm ni?2 Lalte 5:1-27. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

TUI chunga mipa hi en teh. A huai nasa ngei mai, a ni lawm ni? Kha sangha khan amah a dawlh dawn! He mipa hi tunge ni i hria em? A hming chu Jona a ni. Chuti taka buaina a tawh dan i en ang u.

Jona chu Jehova zawlnei a ni a. Zawlnei Elisha thih hnu rei loteah Jehovan Jona hnenah: ‘Ninevi khawpui ropui takah kal la. Chuta mite that lohna chu a nasa em em a, chumi chungchang chu an hnena i sawi ka duh e,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Mahse Jonan kal a duh lo va. Chuvangin Ninevi pan lohna lama kal lawngah a chuang a. A tlan bo vangin Jona chungah Jehova a lawm lo va. Chuvangin thlipui nasa deuh A tlehtir a. A nasa khawp a, lawng chu a pil a hlauhawm hial a. Lawngpute chuan an hlau em em a, tanpui turin an pathiante an au va. A tawpah Jonan: ‘Van leh leilung siamtu Pathian, Jehova ka bia a. Tin Jehovan ti tura min hrilh chu ka tlan bo san a ni,’ tiin a hrilh a. Tichuan lawngpute chuan: ‘Thlipui tireh turin i chungah enge kan tih ang? tiin an zawt a.

‘Tuipuiah mi paih thla ula, tuipui fawn chu a reh mai ang,’ Jona chuan a ti a. Lawngpute chuan paih an duh lo va, mahse thlipui a nasa zual vangin a tawpah chuan Jona chu an paih thla ta a. Thlipui a reh nghal a, tuipui fawn a reh nghal a.

Jona chu tuia a pilin sangha lian puiin amah a dawlh a. Mahse a thi lo. Ni thum leh zan thum chhung chu sangha pum chhungah chuan a awm a. Jehova thu awih a Ninevi-a a kal lo chu pawi a ti em em a. Chuvangin enge a tih tak i hria em?

Tanpuina dilin Jehova hnenah Jona a tawngtai a. Tin Jehovan sangha chu khawmualah Jona a luak chhuahtir a. Chumi hnuah chuan Jona chu Ninevi-ah a kal ta a. Hei hian Jehova sawi apiang kan tih a pawimawhzia min zirtir lawm ni?Bible-a Jona bu. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HEl HI Pathianin a zawlnei Isaia a hmuhtir ni awm Paradis lem a ni. Isaia chu Jona hnu rei loteah a awm a.

Paradis chu “huan’’ tihna a ni. He lehkhabua kan hmuh tawh thil engemaw a hriat chhuahtir che em? Pathian Jehovan Adama leh Evi tana huan mawi tak a siam nen a inang hle mai lawm ni? Mahse leilung pumpui hi paradis a ni ngai ang em?

Jehovan a zawlnei Isaia chu Pathian mite tana paradis thar lo awm tur chanchin ziak turin a hrilh a. ‘Chinghniate leh beramte inremin an cheng za ang a. Bawng notete leh sakeibaknei notete an tla za ang a, tin naupang te tak tein anmahni a enkawl ang.Nausen pawh rul tur nei kianga a infiam pawhin tihnat a ni lo vang,’ a ti.

Tam tak chuan: ‘Chu chu a lo ni thei ngai lo vang. Leilungah buaina a awm reng thin a, a la awm leh zel ang,’ an ti ang. Mahse ngaihtuah teh: Pathianin Adama leh Evi kha in eng ang nge a pek?

Pathianin Adama leh Evi chu paradis-ah a dah a. Pathian thu an awih loh vang chauhvin a ni an in mawi tak an hloh va, an tar a, an thih ni. Pathian chuan amah hmangaihtu mite hnenah Adama leh Evi hloh tawh hnu ngei chu a pe ang tih a tiam a ni.

Paradis thar lo awm turah chuan engmahin an tina emaw an tiboral lo vang. Remna tha famkim a awm ang a. Mipui zawng zawng an hriselin an hlim ang. A tira Pathianin ni se a tih ang chiah chu a ni ang. Pathianin chu chu a thlentir dan tur chu a hnu lamah kan hria ang.Isaia 11:6-9; Thu Puan 21:3, 4. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ENGVANGINNGE he mipa hi Jehova hnena a tawngtai i hria em? Engvanginnge heng lehkhathawnte hi Jehova maicham hmaa a dah? Mipa hi Hezekia a ni. Israel chhimlam hnam hniha lal a ni. Tin buaina a ngah hle mai a. Engvanginnge?

Assuria sipai rualten hmarlam hnam 10 an tihchhiat tawh vang a ni. Chung mipuite chu an that loh em vangin Jehovan chu chu a thlentir a ni. Tin tunah Assuria sipai rualte chu hnam hnih ram do turin an lo kal a.

Assuria lal chuan Lal Hezekia hnenah lehkha a thawn hlim a ni a. Chung lehkhathawnte chu heta Pathian hmaa Hezekian a dahte hi chu chu an ni. Lehkhathawnte chuan Jehova an nuihsan a, inpe turin Hezekia an hriih a. Chuvang chuan Hezekia a tawngtai a: ‘Aw Jehova, Assuria lal lak ata min chhanhim ang che. Tichuan hnam zawng zawngin nangmah chauh hi Pathian i ni tih an hria ang,’ tiin. Jehovan Hezekia a ngaithla em?

Hezekia chu lal tha a ni a. Israel hnam 10 rama lal tha lote ang emaw, a pa mi tha lo LaI Ahaza ang emaw a ni lo. Hezekia chu Jehova dan zawng zawng zawm turin a fimkhur a. Chuvangin Hezekia tawngtai zawh hnuah, zawlnei Isaian Jehova hnena mi he thuchah hi a thawn a: ‘Assuria lal chu Jerusalem-ah a lo lut lo vang a. A sipaite tumah a hnaiah pawh an lo kal lo vang. Khawpuiah thal pakhat mah an kap lut lo vang,’ tih hi. He mi pheka milem hi en teh. Heng sipai thi zawng zawng hi tute nge an nih i hria em? Assuria-mite an ni. Jehovan a vantirhkoh a tir a, tin zan khatah vantirhkohvin Assuria sipaite 185,000 a tihlum a. Chutichuan Assuria lal chuan a bansan a, a haw ta a.

Hnam hnihte ram chhanhim a ni ta, tichuan mipuite chuan muanna an nei ta rih a. Mahse Hezekia thih hnuah a fapa Manassea chu lal a lo ni a. Manassea leh a hnua a fapa Amona chu lal tha lo deuh an ni ve ve a. Tichuan ram chu pawikhawihna leh pawngneknain a khat leh a. Lalber Amona chu ama chhiahhlawhten an tihhlum hnuah, a fapa Josia chu hnam hnih ram Iala siam a ni.2 Lalte 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

1SRAEL chhim lam hnam hniha lalber a nihin Josia chu kum riat chauh a ni. Chu chu lalber ni tur chuan a naupang em em. Chuvangin a tirah upa thenkhatin hnam awp turin an tanpui a.

Josia chu lalber a nib atanga kum sarihah Jehova a zawng tan a. Lalber tha Davida, Jehosaphata leh Hezekia te a entawn a. Tin, tleirawl mai a la nib laiin Josia chuan huai takin thil a ti a.

Hun rei tak chhung chu Israel-mi tam berte chu an tha lo em em a. Pathian dik lote an bia a. Milem hmaah te an kun a. Tichuan Josia chu a mite nen a kal chhuak a, chu ram atang chuan biakna dik lo an tikiang tan ta a. Mipui tam takin pathian dik lote an biak vangin chu chu hna ropui deuh a ni. Hetah hian Josia leh a miten milemte an chhut keh lai i hmu thei.

A hnuah, Josian Jehova biak in siamthat hna enkawltuah mi pathum a dah a. Mipui hnen atangin tangka an la khawm a, an tih tur thawh nan chung mite hnenah chuan pek a ni a. Biak ina an thawh laiin, puithiam lal Hilkian chutah chuan thil pawimawh em em a hmu chhuak a. Hmanlaia Jehovan Mosia a ziahtir dan bu ngei chu a ni. Kum tam tak hloh a ni tawh a.

Lehkhabu chu Josia hnenah an kalpui a, a hnenah a chhiartir a. A han ngaihthlak chuan mipuiin Pathian dan an zawm lo tih a hre thei a. Chumi chungchangah chuan a lungngai em em a, tichuan a silhfen a pawtthler a, heta i hmuh ang hian. ‘He lehkhabua ziak dante hi kan paten an zawm loh vangin, kan chungah Jehova a thinur a ni,’ a ti a. Josia chuan puithiam lai Hilkia chu, an chungah Jehovan enge a tih dawn tih hmu chhuak turin thu a pe a. Hilkia chu zawlneinu Huldai hnenah a kal a, a zawt a. Josia hnena a hawn turin Jehova hnena mi he thuchah hi a pe a: ‘Jerusalem leh mipui zawng zawng chu pathian dik lote an biak leh, ram chu that lohnaa tihkhah a nib avangin hrem a ni ang. Mahse, nang, Josia hian a tha chu i tih avangin chu hremna chu i thih hnuah lo chuan a lo thleng lo vang,’ tih hi.2 Chronicles 34:1-28. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HE TLANGVAL, miten an nuihsana hi en teh. Tunge a nih hi hria em? Hei hi Jeremia a ni. Pathian zawlnei pawimawh em em a ni.

Lalber Josian chu ram ata milemte a tihboral hnu lawkah, Jehovan a zawlnei ni turin Jeremia hi a hrilh a. Amaherawhchu Jeremian zawlnei ni tur chuan la naupang lutukah a inngai a. Mahse Jehovan amah a tanpui ang tih a hrilh a.

Jeremian Israel-mite chu thil tha lo tih bansan turin a hrilh a: ‘Hnamtea mite biak pathiante chu a dik lo an ni,’ a ti a. Mahse Israel-mi tam takin Pathian dik Jehova biak aiin milemte an be zawk dawn si a. Jeremian mipui hnenah an that lohna vangin Pathianin anmahni a hrem ang tih a hrilh lai chuan amah an nuihsan lek a.

Kumte a lo rai a. Josia a thi a, thla thum hnuah a fapa Jehoiakima lalber a lo ni a. Jeremian mipui a hrilh zel a: ‘ln kawng tha lote in thlak loh chuan Jerusalem hi tihchhiat a ni ang,’ tiin. Puithiamten Jeremia an man a: ‘Heng thilte hi i sawi vangin tihhlum tur i ni,’ tiin an au khum a. Tin Israel-a mi liante an hrilh a: ‘Kan khawpui nek zawnga thu a sawi vangin Jeremia hi tihhlum tur a ni,’ tiin.

Tunah Jeremian enge a tih ang? A hlau lo. An vaia hnenah: ‘Heng thilte hi in hnena sawi turin Jehovan mi tir a ni. In nun kawng tha lote hi thlak loh chuan, Jehovan Jerusalem a tichhia ang. Mahse hei hi hre ngei ngei rawh u: Mi tihhlum chuan, thil dik lo tih nei lo mi in tihlum a ni ang,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Miliante chuan Jeremia an tihlum lo va, mahse Israel-mite chuan an kawng tha lo chu an thlak chuang lo va. A hnuah Babulon lai Nebukadnezara a lo kal a, Jerusalem a do va. Babulon-ah sang tam tak a hruai a. Hriat ngai loh miten hriat ngai loh ramah i in ata kal bopui che sela eng ang nge ni ang tih ngaihtuah teh!Jeremia 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Lalte 24:1-17. LALBER Nebukadnezaran Israel-mi lehkhathiam tha zawng zawngte Babulon-ah a kal bopui a. A hnuah an zing atangin lalber chuan tlangval hmeltha leh fel berte a thlang a. Chung zinga pali chu heta tlangval i hmuhte hi an ni. Pakhat chu Daniela a ni a, a dang pathumte chu Babulon-miten Shadraka, Mesaka leh Abednegoa tia an vuahte chu an ni.

Nebukadnezzara chuan tlangvalte chu a lal ina rawngbawl tura zirtir a tum a. Kum thum a zirtir hnuah harsatna tihvenpuitu turin a fel berte chauh a thlang ang. Zirtir an nib chhungin lalber chuan tlangvalte chu chak leh hrisel an nih a duh a. Chuvangin, an vaiin amah leh a chhungten an dawn ang chaw leh uain tha a chhiahhlawhten an pe tur a ni tih thu a pe a.

Tlangval Daniela hi en teh. Nebukadnezzara chhiahhlawh Ashpenaza hnenah enge a sawi i hria em? Daniela chuan lalber dawhkana mi thil thate chu a ei duh lo tih a hrilh a. Mahse Ashpenaza chu a mangang a. ‘Enge in ei a, enge in in tur tih lalberin a rel tawh a. Tin tlangval dangte anga hrisela in!an lob chuan mi tihlum mai thei a sin,’ a ti a.

Chuvangin Daniela chu Ashpenazan amah leh a thian pathumte vengtua a dah hnenah a kal a: ‘Khawngaih takin ni 10 min enchhin rawh. Ei tur thlai leh in turin tui min pe la. Tichuan lalber chaw eitu tlangvalte nen min khaikhin la, tunge lang tha zawk en ang che,’ a ti a.

Vengtu chuan chu chu rem a.Tin ni 10 a kim hun chuan Daniela leh a thian pathumte chu tlangval dang zawng zawng aiin hrisel zawkin an lang a. Chuvangin vengtu chuan lalberin chawmna a pek aiah thlai a eitir zui ta zel a.

Kum thum hnuah chuan zawng zawng chu Nebukadnezzara hnenah an hruai An vaia a biak theuh hnuah, chuan Daniela leh a pathumte chu tha a ti a. Chuvangin amah puitu a lai inah a dah a. lalberin Daniela, Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te chuan zawhna a zawhin emaw, thil khirh harsa a pekin, a puithiam te emaw mi fing dang zawng zawngte ai pawhin a let 10-a tam an hria a.Daniela 1:1-21. LALBER Nebukadnezzaran Israel-mi lehkha thiam ber berte Babulon-a a kalpui chin kum 10 chuang a ni tawh a. Tin tunah enge lo thleng hi en teh! Jerusalem chu hal ral mek a ni. Tin Israel-mi tihhlum lohva awmte chu mi-tangte anga Babulon-a hruai an ni.

Mipuiin an kawng tha lote an thlak loh chuan an chunga thil lo thleng tura zawlneite sawi kha hei hi a ni tih hre reng la. Mahse Israel-mite chuan zawlneite thu an ngaithla lo va. Jehova biak aiin pathian dik lote an be zawk zel a. Chuvangin mipuiin hrem an phu a ni. Pathian zawlnei Ezekielan Israel-mite thil tih tha lote chanchin min hrilh vangin chu chu kan hria a ni.

Ezekiela chu tunge ni i hria em? He Jerusalem tihchhiatna nasa tak thlen hma kum 10 chuanga Lalber Nebukadnezzaran Babulon-a a hruai tlangvalte zinga pakhat a ni. Daniela leh a thiante pathum Shadraka, Meshaka leh Abednegoa te pawh chumi rual chuan Babulon-a hruai an ni.

Babulon-a Ezekiela la awm laiin, Jerusalem biak ina thil tha lote Jehovan a hmuhtir a. Chu chu Jehovan thiltihmakin a ti a. A taktakah chuan Ezekiela chu Babulon-ah a la awm a, mahse Jehovan biak ina awm thil tinreng a hmuhtir a. Tichuan Ezekiela hmuh chu a rapthlak a nia!

‘Heta biak ina mipuiin thil tenawm an tihte hi en teh. Rul leh ran dangte lema khat bangte hi en teh. Tin anmahni betu Israel-mite hi en teh!’ tiin Jehovan Ezekiela a hrilh a. Ezekielan chung thilte chu a hmu thei a, thil lo nih dante chu a ziak a.

‘Israel-mite hruaituten a rukin enge an tih i hmu em?’ Jehovan Ezekiela a zawt a. Aw, chu pawh chu a hmu thei. Mipa 70 an awm a, an vaiin pathian dik lo an bia a. ‘Jehovan min hmu lo. Ram hi a kalsan tawh,’ an ti a.

Tin Jehovan biak in hmar lam kawngkaa hmeichhe thenkhat a hmuhtir a. Chutah chuan pathian dik lo Tammuza biain a thu a. Tin sawng Jehova biak in luhnaa mipate saw en teh! 25 vel an awm a. Ezekielan anmahni a hmu a. Khawchhak lam hawiin an kun a, ni an bia a ni.!

‘Heng mite hian mi zahna an nei lo. Thil tha lo an ti mai ni lovin, ka biak in ngeiah lo kalin an ti,’ Jehovan a ti a. Chuvangin Jehova chuan: ‘Ka thinur tha chak an hria ang. Tin tihboral an nih hunah pawi ka tih sak lovang,’ tiin a tiam a. Chung thilte chu Jehovan Ezekiela a hmuhtir hnu kum thum vel chauhvah Israel-mite chu Lalber Nebukadnezzara lakah an hel a. Chuvangin anmahni do turin a kal a. Kum khat leh a chanve hnuah Babulon-miten Jerusalem kulh an su tlang a, khawpui an hal ta vek a. Mipui tam ber chu tihhlum emaw Babulon-a mi-tang anga hruai emaw an ni.

Engvanginnge he boralna nasa tak hi Jehovan Israel-mite chungah a thlentir? E, Jehova thu an ngaithla lo va, a dante an zawm loh vang a ni. Hei hian kan tan Jehova sawi apiang tih zel a pawimawhzia a tilang.

A tirah chuan Israel ramah mi tlemte an awm phal a m.Lalber Nebukadnezzara chuan chungho enkawltuah chuan Juda-mi a hming Gedalia a dah a. Mahse Israel-mi thenkhatin Gedalia chu an that a. Chu thil tha lo chu a thlen tak avang chuan Babulon-mite an lo kal ang a, anmahni an tiboral vek ang tih mipui chuan an hlau ta a. Tichuan an hnenah Jeremia an kal luihtir a, Aigupta-ah an tlan bo ta a.

Chu vang chuan Israel ram chu mi tumah awm lovin a awm ta a. Kum 70 chhungin ramah chuan tumah an cheng lo. A ruak vek a. Mahse Jehovan kum 70 hnuah chu ramah chuan mipuite a hruai kir leh ang tih a tiam tawh a. Chumi chhung chuan Babulon rama Pathian mite chungah enge lo thleng i en ang u.2 Lalte 25:1-26; Jeremia 29:10; Ezekiela 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate
